brief.title: Happy cartoon puppy figurine
brief.summary: A stylised puppy sitting up, with a big head tilted to one side, an open smiling mouth with its tongue out, floppy ears and a wagging tail. It is sculpted as one smooth blended (metaball) shape, then split into the three pieces it prints as: the body, the head (which carries the collar and tag) and the tail. The head is glued onto the body at the neck, on a locating peg, along the collar's lower edge so the collar hides the joint; the tail is trimmed to the rump's surface and glued on. Eyes, nose, mouth, tongue, ears, spots, cheek blush, toe lines and the collar with its tag are separate coloured shells placed on the surface, so they follow it when parameters change.

key_dimensions.name: Length

key_dimensions.name: Neck peg
key_dimensions.note: at 175 mm height: Ø × length, in a socket 0.3 mm larger

features: Sitting pose: front legs straight, hind legs folded with feet forward
Big head (head_scale) tilted sideways (head_tilt_deg) for a cheerful look
Open smiling mouth with the tongue out (mouth_open, tongue_length)
Shiny eyes with highlights, or closed happy ^ ^ eyes (eye_style), raised eyebrows
Floppy dark ears (ear_flare_deg) and a wagging tail (tail_wag_deg)
Eye patch and back spot, pink cheek blush, toe lines on all four paws
Red collar with a gold tag
Prints as three parts: body (with the neck peg), head (with the collar, tag and socket) and tail, glued together
assumptions: Organic, sculpted shape: Blender metaballs give smooth blended forms that B-rep cannot
Coloured details are separate overlapping shells (one colour each) so each part can be printed multi-colour or in one colour; a slicer merges them
Printed upright with supports (chin, tongue, ears and tail overhang) or in resin; no manufacturing process is declared because hitlcad's FDM check assumes printing without supports
Parts are glued, with a 0.1 mm glue line at each joint
Bottom of the body is cut flat (about 1% of the height) so it stands steadily
open_questions: Breed or colouring you have in mind (e.g. golden retriever, dalmatian, beagle)?
Pose: sitting (current), standing, or lying down?
Will it be 3D printed, and in one colour or several?

body.role: the sitting body and legs, with spots, toe lines and the neck peg; stands on its flat bottom

head.role: the head: face, ears, tongue, collar and tag; a socket takes the body's neck peg

tail.role: the wagging tail with its cream tip, trimmed to the rump

requirements.text: Looks happy and cute: smile, tongue out, wagging tail, tilted head
